categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Boiln Plastics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the modified plastics industry, focusing on high-performance modified nylon, modified polyester, engineering polyolefins, color masterbatches, and specialty engineering plastics. Its products serve sectors including power tools, automotive parts, household appliances, and consumer electronics. The company also engages in the production and sales of color masterbatches and functional masterbatches.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer modification technologies to enhance plastics with properties such as flame retardancy, impact resistance, high toughness, and ease of processing. It has mature mass production capabilities for various specialized materials including color-stable toughened nylon, halogen-free flame-retardant PC and ABS alloys, high-transparency alloys for smart home applications, and high glass fiber reinforced high-temperature nylon. The firm emphasizes R&D in material formulation, additive development, and processing techniques, supported by patented technologies and a dedicated technical team.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading international industrial enterprises in the power tools, automotive components, household appliances, and consumer electronics industries. The company maintains long-term stable partnerships with these global clients, providing customized high-value material solutions. Its products are used in demanding applications requiring high performance and reliability.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with a strong presence in the East China region, which accounts for over 66% of revenue. It also has significant export sales to North America, Southeast Asia, South America, and other regions. Subsidiaries and production facilities exist in Singapore and Malaysia, supporting international trade and regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Boiln Plastics operates primarily in the midstream segment of the plastics supply chain, focusing on the modification and compounding of base polymers into high-performance materials. It procures raw materials such as PA6, PA66, PC, PP, and additives from upstream suppliers and supplies modified plastics to downstream industrial manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages in high-value, high-technology niche markets. R&D focuses include enhancing material strength, modulus, wear resistance, thermal stability, color performance, and developing low-carbon, recycled, and sustainable materials. It targets emerging sectors like low-altitude economy, embodied intelligent robotics, and advanced composites, aiming to expand applications and improve product differentiation. Talent development and supply chain optimization are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of modified plastic products and color masterbatches. The company operates on a product sales model, serving both domestic and international customers. It also earns investment income from financial products but this is non-core.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While the company is not the largest in terms of production volume or revenue in the domestic modified plastics industry, it holds strong competitive advantages in specific niche segments due to superior technology, process capabilities, and product profitability. It has established a reputable brand and stable relationships with world-class industrial customers, positioning itself as an important participant in the global modified plastics supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 645 million, a 27.37% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 141 million, up 22.24%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with a net asset base exceeding RMB 1.2 billion. It maintains positive operating cash flow and has ongoing capital investments to expand production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Boiln Plastics emphasizes delivering customized, high-performance modified plastics that address specific customer challenges in demanding industrial applications. Its value proposition centers on advanced material technology, stable product quality, and comprehensive technical support services. The company differentiates itself through innovation in material formulations, patented technologies, and a customer-first approach that enhances client product performance and competitiveness.
